introduction: Iván (15) had been presumed dead after getting lost mysteriously a couple of years ago. Now he’s back after having been found in the Amazonian jungle by Meshia (18). She is a Matsigenka girl with a broken heart who seizes the opportunity to go to Quillabamba to follow her city dreams. Iván is catatonic, has some strange nightmares, mental blackouts and can’t seem to go back to being himself again. Among dark delusions and crossed memories, his new realities live under a lurking shadow.源自：https://www.mardelplatafilmfest.com/37/en/pelicula/punku
